-- Planted by the trust self-test, plant V2c-R1 (B3 of ruling R-V10): a false
-- axiom added to the root module and a theorem proved from it, placed before the
-- gate command. The gate audits the imported modules' constants, never the root
-- module's own, so at the base this is not refused. Rule 4 of addendum V2c
-- refuses the root for holding a command other than imports and the gate, and for
-- declaring a constant when the gate runs.
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd liftCoreM <| Lean.addDecl (.axiomDecl
  { name := `rvV2cRootAxiom, levelParams := [], type := Lean.mkConst ``False, isUnsafe := false })

theorem rvV2cRootFalse : (1 : Nat) = 2 := rvV2cRootAxiom.elim
